## Episode Thesis

The episode is a pre-election look at Swedish household tax issues with Di personal finance expert Frida Bratt: property tax, capital gains tax on home sales, the proposed bank tax, and the plan to use the state-owned SBAB to push down mortgage rates. Bratt thinks a bank tax is likely if Magdalena Andersson forms a government, and expects banks to pass it on through mortgage rates 0.2-0.3 percentage points higher. The hosts see little overall stock market effect from the election, but say a bank tax would take money straight out of bank profits. No specific listed bank is named as a target.
